You don’t need a louder personal brand. You need a clearer one — and a place online that proves it.

undefined

This guide is for students turning campus work into career proof who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

undefined

Do this next

  1. Drop internal course codes; explain the problem
  2. Show screenshots or demos, not just titles
  3. Add one line on what you learned

Design for the skim

Assume ten seconds. If education, skills, and contact aren’t obvious, a busy recruiter won’t hunt. Pair a designed home with a Hire Me page that prints cleanly.

Translate campus work

Replace “CSE Mini Project” with the problem you solved, who it helped, and what changed. Faculty titles impress faculty. Outcomes impress employers.

How a website helps you stand out

Campus work becomes impressive when you translate it into problem → action → result language employers use.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.cyou, create on dash.mybexo.cyou, share on yourname.mybexo.cyou. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • Drop internal course codes; explain the problem
  • Show screenshots or demos, not just titles
  • Add one line on what you learned

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
